programme.title: Visiones
programme.desc: Tras sufrir un grave accidente, una mujer y su marido se mudan a una casa de campo con el fin de recuperar su estabilidad emocional. Pero pronto comienza a tener inquietantes visiones que su marido no percibe, y le preocupa que su mujer, lejos de recuperarse, esté recayendo. La noticia de su embarazo supone un soplo de aire fresco y la alegría parece que vuelve al hogar. Además, la futura madre se ha hecho amiga de otra en las clases de gimnasia para embarazadas, pero las visiones no cesan.

programme.desc: Programa religioso sobre temas de interés cultural, histórico, católico, moral y familiar. ''Últimas preguntas'' analiza la presencia de la Iglesia en la cultura y la sociedad actual. programme.title: Pesadilla en el infierno con Gordon Ramsey
programme.desc: El chef británico se lanza a la carretera para recorrer Estados Unidos con una misión: reflotar restaurantes fallidos con la ayuda de 'Hell on wheels', su espectacular camión-cocina de alta tecnología de 21 metros. Aunque el reto se endurece para Ramsay: dentro del objetivo de comprometerse a llevarlos a la salvación, solo dispondrá de únicamente 24 horas.Para conocer qué problemas tiene el local, previamente el presentador ya ha acudido de incógnito junto a miembros de su equipo. programme.title: Yellowjackets
programme.desc: "Yellowjackets" tells the narrative of a team of wildly talented high-school girls soccer players who survive a plane crash deep in the Ontario wilderness. The series chronicles their descent from a complicated but thriving team to warring, cannibalistic clans, while also tracking the lives they have attempted to piece back together. Sophie Nélisse, Jasmin Savoy Brown, Sophie Thatcher and Sammi Hanratty star as the teenagers, while Melanie Lynskey, Tawny Cypress, Christina Ricci and Juliette Lewis portray their adult counterparts as they reveal the truth about their survival 25 years later.

programme.title: Outride the Devil: A Morning With Doc Holliday
programme.desc: Kit Hussey presents the highlights from the last fourteen years of Doc Holliday's life, which ended in a gunfight.

programme.title: The Star Packer
programme.desc: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow.

programme.title: Colorado Serenade
programme.desc: One night, while out riding his horse, Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) comes upon a stagecoach being robbed by bandits. He intervenes and rescues the passengers, including a newly appointed judge, Roy Hilton (Forrest Taylor), who's traveling to the nearby town of Rawhide to bring law and order to the community. After witnessing Dean's heroics, the judge enlists the cowboy to help him, but their efforts are complicated by the arrival of mysterious drifter Nevada (David Sharpe).

programme.title: Tumbleweed Trail
programme.desc: Scheming to steal Bill Ryan's (Kermit Maynard) cattle to pay a debt, his half-brother, Brad Barton (Bob Duncan), has his men shoot the rancher. With Bill left for dead, Brad and corrupt lawyer Alton Small (Ted Adams) produce a forged will that disinherits Bill's teenage daughter, Robin (Shirley Patterson), and son Freckles (Johnny McGovern). Aid arrives in the form of cowboys Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), who help Robin fight for her rightful property.

programme.title: West to Glory
programme.desc: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), an undercover U.S. agent, is sent to a Mexican border town to protect the valuable Lopez diamond. One day he and his friend Soapy (Roscoe Ates) attend a party thrown by Don Lopez (Harry Vejar), a wealthy prospector who also holds large reserves of gold. After Lopez insists that the mysterious Maria (Dolores Castle) wear the precious gem, Eddie becomes suspicious that she may be in league with the gang that recently stole some of Lopez's gold and killed one of his men.

programme.title: Wild Country
programme.desc: Bandit Rip Caxton (I. Stanford Jolley) escapes from prison, and U.S. Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) track him to a small town. There, Caxton kills a sheriff, and, with the help of crooked local saloon boss Clark Varney (Douglas Fowley), installs a conspirator in the dead lawman's place. Meanwhile, Eddie comes across Martha Devery (Peggy Wynn), the distressed daughter of the former sheriff, and promises her he will bring the villains to justice.

programme.title: Black Hills
programme.desc: When their father is shot by Dan Kirby (Terry Frost) after discovering a gold mine on his ranch, Larry Hadley (Steve Drake) and his sister, Janet (Shirley Patterson), ask foreman Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) for help in retaining their land. Eddie's arrival with sidekick Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) disrupts Dan's plans to take over the property. Desperate to obtain the ranch, Dan blackmails accountant Tuttle (Bill Fawcett) into forging a document that will help him take control.

programme.title: Bells of Coronado
programme.desc: An insurance agent investigating a mine owner's death is pitted against foreign agents and uranium smugglers.

programme.title: The Lucky Texan
programme.desc: Jerry Mason (John Wayne), fresh out of college back East, heads home to Texas to join a blacksmith business with family friend Jake (George Hayes). But when they discover a gold nugget in a horseshoe, they're led down a dangerous path, as crooks Joe Cole (Yakima Canutt) and Harris (Lloyd Whitlock) scheme to take the rock from the unsuspecting Jerry and Jake. This ultimately gets Jake shot and wounded, lands Jerry in jail unjustly and leaves the pair plotting to get revenge on the criminals.

programme.title: In Old Amarillo
programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

programme.title: Down Missouri Way
programme.desc: In this musical, agriculture professor Jane Colwell (Martha O'Driscoll) is seeking a quiet getaway when she takes her prized mule off to visit an Ozarks farming community. But upon arrival she is stunned to discover a film crew diligently at work on a new movie. Soon, Jane and her mule companion are swept up in the filmmaking frenzy. While the photogenic mule upstages the production's human star (Renee Godfrey), Jane finds herself falling for the feature's dashing producer (William Wright).

programme.title: Jericho
programme.desc: Jericho (Mark Valley) wakes up with no memory, but it's apparent that he's quite skilled with a gun. He is befriended by Joshua (Leon Coffee), who appears to be his polar opposite: He's a black man and true believer in the Lord, whereas Jericho is white and doubtful of everything, especially himself. Side by side, they attempt to piece together the amnesiac's past, which may or may not have something to do with a robbery, and either way is somehow connected to a town that's also called Jericho.

programme.title: The Promise
programme.desc: Brilliant medical student Michael (Oscar Isaac) meets beautiful dance instructor Ana (Charlotte Le Bon) in late 1914. Their shared Armenian heritage sparks an attraction that explodes into a romantic rivalry between Michael and Ana's boyfriend (Christian Bale), an American photojournalist who's dedicated to exposing the truth. As the Ottoman Empire crumbles into war-torn chaos, their conflicting passions must be deferred as they join forces to get themselves and their people to safety.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.title: Killing Streets
programme.desc: When he's informed that his twin brother has died in Beirut, basketball coach Craig Brandt (Michael Paré) flies to Lebanon to investigate for himself. His brother was a U.S. Marine who, according to the military, died in an explosion during an anti-terrorist operation. At the U.S. Embassy, Craig meets with Charles Wolf (Lorenzo Lamas), who backs up the official story. Nevertheless, Craig has the uncanny feeling that his brother is still alive -- and that he's the only one who can save him.

programme.title: Desert Sands
programme.desc: Sheik El Zanal (Keith Larsen) and his faithful sister, Princess Zara (Marla English), plot revenge on an outpost of the French Foreign Legion 15 years after their parents are murdered in cold blood by men dressed as legionnaires. After the brutal massacre of a patrol unit, the fort's newly assigned commander, Capt. David Malcolm (Ralph Meeker), battles the cunning El Zanal and his henchmen while waiting for reinforcements -- and finding himself unexpectedly attracted to the beautiful Zara.

programme.title: Cast a Giant Shadow
programme.desc: In this fact-based film, distinguished U.S. Army Col. David Marcus (Kirk Douglas) is enlisted by the Israelis to perform the difficult task of preparing their fledgling nation for battle against the Arabs. Before long, he feuds with the local leaders, quits his post and goes back home to his pregnant wife (Angie Dickinson) in the United States. However, Marcus, who is Jewish himself, soon has a crisis of faith and decides to return to duty to help the untrained Israelis form an army.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

Tom O'Bannion (Gerald Mohr) are astronauts aboard the spaceship MR-1, the first mission to Mars. Shortly after their rocket reaches the mysterious red planet, the band of brave space explorers discovers monstrous yet highly intelligent alien life forms, which first attack, then deliver a haunting word of warning intended for all mankind.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Invisible Invaders
programme.desc: When Dr. Karol Noymann (John Carradine) is killed in an explosion, aliens inhabit his corpse and use it to communicate with his former colleague, Dr. Adam Penner (Philip Tonge), revealing to him that invisible aliens live on the moon. After this revelation, the aliens set out to wipe out humanity by making zombies from their corpses. To survive, Dr. Penner, his daughter (Jean Byron), Dr. John Lamont (Robert Hutton) and Maj. Bruce Jay (John Agar) all hide in a bunker.

programme.title: Attack of the Puppet People
programme.desc: Secretary Sally Reynolds (June Kenny) is grateful to her seemingly kind boss, Mr. Franz (John Hoyt), when he introduces her to a dapper young man, Bob (John Agar). Little does she know that Franz is more than a doll maker. Really, he is really a merciless mad scientist who fights off loneliness by shrinking people and forcing them to serve as his living dolls. But, when he shrinks Sally and her new beau, they refuse to be his playthings and escape into a dangerous world that towers over them.

programme.title: The Monster That Challenged the World
programme.desc: An earthquake doesn't just shake up Southern California -- it awakens a nest of monsters lurking in the Salton Sea. These bloodthirsty sea snails are gobbling up anyone who sets foot in the water. And when the creatures move on to land in search of wider hunting grounds, they launch a reign of terror that threatens to spread across the whole country. Humanity's only hope rests on a crew of intrepid scientists and Lt. Cmdr. John Twillinger (Tim Holt).

programme.title: The Man From Planet X
programme.desc: From his observatory, Scottish professor Elliot (Raymond Bond) keeps close watch on Planet X, whose orbit is coming close to Earth. During the planet's approach, an alien ambassador appears but falls prey to maniacal scientist Dr. Mears (William Schallert). Returning the distinct lack of hospitality, the extraterrestrial uses his otherworldly powers to turn those he encounters into mindless drones. Elliot tries to stop the creature before everyone is turned into a zombie.

programme.title: The Beast With a Million Eyes
programme.desc: An alien lands by spaceship and makes birds, cows and other animals attack a ranch family.

programme.title: Lord of Illusions
programme.desc: Private eye Harry D'Amour travels to Los Angeles and meets with a new client, Dorothea Swann. Swann reveals that she and her husband — famed magician Philip Swann — have been targeted by a religious cult experimenting with reincarnation. After Philip dies on stage in the midst of a dangerous trick, D'Amour must struggle to protect Dorothea from the ruthless cult members and their newly reanimated religious leader, Nix.

programme.title: Vampires on Bikini Beach
programme.desc: Californians (Jennifer Badham, Todd Kaufman) try to save their beach from a ghoul and his gang.

programme.title: Secret of Deep Harbor
programme.desc: A reporter (Ron Foster) covers the waterfront and catches his girlfriend's (Merry Anders) father (Barry Kelley) smuggling gangsters.

programme.title: Raiders of the Seven Seas
programme.desc: A fierce pirate, Barbarossa (John Payne) captures a Spanish ship with bravado. Discovering the beautiful Contessa Alida (Donna Reed) on board, Barbarossa falls for the elegant aristocrat, but she is to wed the sailor Jose Salcedo (Gerald Mohr). Although Alida is resistant to Barbarossa's charms, she slowly warms up to him, particularly after she discovers that Salcedo isn't the man that she thought he was. Naturally, Barbarossa proceeds to sort things out with a series of sword battles.

programme.title: The Living Ghost
programme.desc: When wealthy banker Walter Craig (Gus Glassmire) disappears, former private eye Nick Trayne (James Dunn) comes out of retirement to find the missing man. As Nick gets to know the contentious Craig family, the rich man reappears, but someone has put him in an unresponsive, zombie-like state. Then a member of the family is found stabbed to death, with Walter standing over him. When Walter attacks Nick, it seems that the catatonic banker is the killer, but Nick thinks there is more to the mystery.

programme.title: Ghost of Dragstrip Hollow
programme.desc: Lois Cavendish (Jody Fair) hangs out at a nearby soda shop with her drag racing club. But when she learns the shop might be closed, she calls her wealthy aunt, Anastasia (Dorothy Neumann), for help. Anastasia offers the club the chance to use her mansion as their headquarters -- but with one strange condition: They have to scare away the ghost that haunts her home. When the club decides to throw an all-night monster mash party at the mansion, it becomes clear that something is amiss.

programme.title: One Man's Hero
programme.desc: In 1848, Jon Riley heads a group of Irish-born Roman Catholic soldiers in the U.S. Army. The group faces religious prejudice in the predominantly Protestant military. In the midst of the war against Mexico, Riley and some of his fellow soldiers go to a Catholic Church and are cruelly punished as a result. Because of this, they defect to the Mexican Army, where they meet guerrilla leader Cortina, with whom they forge an unlikely bond.

programme.title: The Gallant Hours
programme.desc: As he retires from the U.S. Navy, Admiral William J. Halsey (James Cagney) recalls the most daunting challenge in his career: the Battle of Guadalcanal in 1942. Ordered to replace a close friend as fleet admiral, Halsey faces a wily and fierce adversary in Japan's Admiral Yamamoto, and spends the grueling months of the campaign confounding expectations of both the enemy and his own staff. Pained by the losses he knows they will endure, Halsey pushes his forces to the brink.

programme.title: Night Fighters
programme.desc: An Irish rebel (Robert Mitchum) blows the whistle on Nazi collaborators in the Irish Republican Army.

programme.title: Ambush Bay
programme.desc: In 1944, Sgt. Steve Corey (Hugh O'Brian) leads a group of U.S. Marines on a covert mission to an island in the Philippines that is occupied by Japanese forces. There, the soldiers learn that the enemy has planted a series of mines to destroy General MacArthur's incoming troops, who are preparing to storm the island. Before the Marines get a chance to relay the information, they suffer a deadly attack, leaving only the valiant Corey and Pfc. James Grenier (James Mitchum) to save the day.

programme.title: Submarine X-1
programme.desc: Cmdr. Richard Bolton was in charge of a submarine that was sunk by a German ship, and he has been blamed for the loss of 50 sailors. Now exonerated of misconduct, he is heading a mission to use minisubs to reach a German battleship commanded by Capt. Erlich. During training, Bolton encounters some of his previous crew members, all of whom harbor grudges against him, which further complicates the already dangerous mission.

programme.title: Tank Battalion
programme.desc: During the Korean War, Sgt. Brad Dunne (Don Kelly) heads a tank battalion consisting of reluctant young recruit Pfc. Danny Collins (Bob Padget) and seasoned soldiers Corp. Corbett (Edward G. Robinson Jr.) and Pfc. Madigan (Frank Gorshin). When guerrillas launch a series of ambushes on a U.S. base camp, Dunne and his men are ordered to lead an offensive against the rebels. But, just as they approach the front lines, a grenade blast disables their tank, stranding them as the enemy approaches.

programme.title: Beach Red
programme.desc: Ordered to help secure a heavily defended Japanese island during World War II, Captain MacDonald (Cornel Wilde) and his Marines land on "Beach Red" and proceed inland against stubborn, murderous resistance. MacDonald is supported by his tough-as-nails gunnery sergeant (Rip Torn), soulful Private Egan (Burr DeBenning) and a group of stalwart Marines who try to block out the horrors that surround them by remembering the women they love back home.

programme.title: Flight From Ashiya
programme.desc: Stationed in Ashiya, Japan, U.S. Air Force Rescue Service members Master Sgt. Mike Takashima (Yul Brynner), Lt. Col. Glenn Stevenson (Richard Widmark) and Lt. John Gregg (George Chakiris) all carry personal demons stemming from a past event. When the orders come down to rescue stranded Japanese survivors of a shipwreck caused by a storm, the three men jump into action. On their way through the still violent storm, each shares the tale from his past that has affected him to this day.

programme.desc: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot.

programme.title: Topkapi
programme.desc: Beautiful thief Elizabeth Lipp (Melina Mercouri) and criminal genius Walter Harper (Maximilian Schell) put together a plan to steal an emerald-encrusted dagger from Istanbul's Topkapi Palace. As part of their crew, they hire small-time hustler Arthur Simon Simpson (Peter Ustinov) to act as their fall guy. When the Turkish secret police capture Simpson at the border, they persuade him to spy on his partners in crime, mistakenly believing that they're Communist agents plotting an assassination.

programme.title: Cul-de-Sac
programme.desc: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). Richard seizes control of the castle, but, as the criminals are pulled further into the isolated world of the strange couple, a volatile test of wills ensues.

Initially represented by a younger lawyer, Crawford eventually defends himself in court, despite not having an alibi.

programme.title: The Captive City
programme.desc: A private investigator informs small-town newspaper editor Jim Austin of corrupt local activity. When the investigator is killed, Austin believes it's an act of revenge, and his own detective work reveals a network of gambling and corruption. Crime boss Murray Sirak controls the whole town, including the police. Sirak answers to his own boss, "Mr. Big," who is seemingly untouchable, but Austin risks his life to expose the truth.

programme.title: Shield for Murder
programme.desc: Corrupt cop Barney Nolan (Edmond O'Brien) is hard up for cash, so he shoots a bookie, relieves him of $25,000 and makes it look like an accident. Unbeknownst to Nolan, however, the entire episode is witnessed by a deaf-mute from across the street. While Nolan struggles to keep the crime a secret from his girlfriend, Patty Winters (Marla English), a series of loose ends pop up, and Nolan soon learns that, although committing a crime is easy, getting away with it is murder.

programme.title: The Organization
programme.desc: When an executive and a night watchman are killed in a San Francisco office building, Lt. Virgil Tibbs is called in to investigate and discovers the watchman was actually killed elsewhere. Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Not as a Stranger
programme.desc: Ambitious medical student Lucas Marsh (Robert Mitchum) aspires to being a doctor with his own practice. Unable to fund his studies himself, he woos the warm, supportive nurse Kristina (Olivia de Havilland), who has the financial resources he needs for him to realize his dreams. The couple marries and moves to a small town, where Lucas works as an assistant to Dr. Runkleman (Charles Bickford). However, after a series of betrayals, Lucas is forced to face life without the help of others.

programme.title: Buona Sera, Mrs. Campbell
programme.desc: During World War II, an Italian villager (Gina Lollobrigida) befriends three American soldiers. Later, when unsure which of them fathered the daughter she has, she invents a dead captain named Campbell, declares herself his widow and accepts support checks from all three soldiers. Twenty years later, a reunion unexpectedly brings the three veterans -- and their wives and children -- back to Italy. Mrs. Campbell panics as she endeavors to keep her lively past from her daughter.

programme.title: Violent Playground
programme.desc: Sgt. Truman (Stanley Baker), a policeman who deals with juvenile delinquents, visits the Murphy household after a theft by the young twins, Mary and Patrick. There he meets their older sister, Cathie (Anne Heywood), and soon begins a romantic involvement with her. However, Cathie's brother, Johnnie (David McCallum), is the leader of an infamous local gang, and doesn't like to see his sister with a cop. Gradually, Truman starts to see a link between Johnnie and a string of local arsons.

programme.title: The Fugitive Kind
programme.desc: When drifter Valentine Xavier (Marlon Brando) arrives in a southern town, he catches the eye of the married Lady Torrance (Anna Magnani) and the oversexed alcoholic, Carol Cutrere (Joanne Woodward). Both vie for his attention, with Lady Torrance emerging victorious, offering Xavier employment in her general store, while her cancer-stricken husband is bedridden upstairs. After impregnating Lady Torrance and butting heads with friends of her husband, Xavier must make a crucial decision.

programme.title: The Malta Story
programme.desc: During World War II, British photo-reconnaissance pilot Peter (Alec Guinness) discovers that the Italians are planning a secret invasion of Malta, a strategically important island nation critical to keeping the Allied supply lines open. Though they have few resources left, Peter and his commanding officer, Frank (Jack Hawkins), resolve to fight off the enemy and save the island. At the same time, Peter struggles to keep his relationship with a local girl from falling apart.

programme.title: The Black Tent
programme.desc: An Englishman (Donald Sinden) learns his army brother (Anthony Steel) married a Bedouin (Anna-Maria Sandri) and fought the Nazis as a guerrilla.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Not as a Stranger
programme.desc: Ambitious medical student Lucas Marsh (Robert Mitchum) aspires to being a doctor with his own practice. Unable to fund his studies himself, he woos the warm, supportive nurse Kristina (Olivia de Havilland), who has the financial resources he needs for him to realize his dreams. The couple marries and moves to a small town, where Lucas works as an assistant to Dr. Runkleman (Charles Bickford). However, after a series of betrayals, Lucas is forced to face life without the help of others.

programme.title: Buona Sera, Mrs. Campbell
programme.desc: During World War II, an Italian villager (Gina Lollobrigida) befriends three American soldiers. Later, when unsure which of them fathered the daughter she has, she invents a dead captain named Campbell, declares herself his widow and accepts support checks from all three soldiers. Twenty years later, a reunion unexpectedly brings the three veterans -- and their wives and children -- back to Italy. Mrs. Campbell panics as she endeavors to keep her lively past from her daughter.

programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate.

programme.title: So Young, So Bad
programme.desc: At the Elmview Corrective School for Girls, the facility's warden, Mr. Riggs (Cecil Clovelly), abuses prisoners and justifies his actions as strict discipline. Dr. John H. Jason (Paul Henreid), the school's head psychologist, and Ruth Levering (Catherine McLeod), an assistant, view Riggs' actions as unethical, and believe he's driving the prisoners further toward delinquency. They're proven correct when several girls at the school attempt an escape.

programme.title: Attack on the Iron Coast
programme.desc: With D-Day fast approaching, the Allied forces of World War II prepare to strike a number of strategic Nazi bases. Leading one such attack, Maj. Jamie Wilson (Lloyd Bridges) concocts a risky plan for what is quickly becoming a suicide mission. With a reckless streak that has cost the lives of many men, Wilson faces the opposition of Capt. Owen Franklin (Andrew Keir), whose son was killed in Wilson's last mission. However, Franklin must put aside his feelings when he is ordered to join the major.

programme.title: A Story of David: The Hunted
programme.desc: Renowned for his courageous deeds as a youth when he slew Goliath, David (Jeff Chandler) inadvertently incurs the wrath of King Saul (Basil Sydney), who is jealous of the hero's popularity. In order to provide peace of mind for the Israelite king, Saul's scheming counselor, Doeg (Peter Arne), encourages the ruler to have David killed. David, aided by his friend Jonathan (David Knight), who is Saul's own son, attempts to survive without overtly clashing with his own people.

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

programme.title: Hell up in Harlem
programme.desc: In Harlem, N.Y., crime boss Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) is gravely injured while escaping a hit ordered by the corrupt district attorney, D'Angelo (Gerald Gordon). As he recovers, his father, Papa Gibbs (Julius W. Harris), assumes control of the gang, which angers Tommy's best henchman, Zach (Tony King), who goes on to collaborate with D'Angelo and frame Papa Gibbs for the murder of Tommy's ex-wife. This sets off a series of bloody betrayals that ricochet within the crime world.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Bucktown, U.S.A.
programme.desc: After his brother's death, Duke Johnson (Fred Williamson) travels to a small Southern town to organize his brother's funeral. During his stay, he decides to revive his brother's nightclub business. However, this venture quickly uncovers the thinly veiled racism and corruption that run rampant in the town. Duke and his friend Aretha (Pam Grier) face demands for bribes and violence from the police. With the arrival of Duke's pal Roy (Thalmus Rasulala), the situation only escalates.

programme.title: Hammer
programme.desc: Hotheaded laborer B.J. Hammer (Fred Williamson) can't go long without ending up in a fight, and, after he comes out on top in a particularly impressive workplace scuffle, word of his brawling skills makes its way to Davis (Bernie Hamilton), a top boxing manager. Hammer is hired by Davis and begins a lucrative career in the ring, only to find out that his new employer wants him to throw a fight and take part in other illicit activities. Hammer reacts to this news violently, and the feud is on.

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: After a robbery in Harlem turns into a scene of mass murder, promising young black police officer William Pope (Yaphet Kotto) is assigned to the case, along with surly, prejudiced Italian-American cop Frank Mattelli (Anthony Quinn). The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money.

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt.

programme.title: The Monkey Hustle
programme.desc: Slick Chicago street hustler Big Daddy Foxx (Yaphet Kotto) lives comfortably off petty confidence scams that he pulls with the help of loyal teenage acolytes Baby D' (Kirk Calloway), Tiny (Donn Harper) and Player (Thomas Carter). His business is jeopardized, however, when he runs afoul of neighborhood racketeer Goldie (Rudy Ray Moore). Their rivalry escalates until the threat of a freeway being built through their neighborhood obliges them to cooperate in order to fight city hall.

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: Amazing Grace
programme.desc: A feisty old woman (Moms Mabley) forces moral support on a big-city candidate (Moses Gunn) for mayor.

programme.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
programme.desc: Mr. Brooks (Leonard Jackson) is an African-American barbershop owner who runs his household with an iron fist. One day, however, Mrs. Brooks (Clarice Taylor) tires of his stern approach and embraces a nonconformist attitude that's more in line with that of their children, including the philosophical Booker T. (D'Urville Martin) and Gideon (Glynn Turman), a black militant. Soon a battle of wills erupts in the Brooks household, and no one is going to readily back down.

programme.title: The Angel Levine
programme.desc: Unable to work due to a back injury, elderly Jewish tailor Morris Mishkin spends his days caring for his ill wife and wishing for happiness. After Morris sees a man die in the street, the man returns to Morris claiming to be a Jewish angel named Alexander Levine, who must perform a miracle within 24 hours to be confirmed as an angel. As his wife's health improves, Morris shows Alexander that renewing his faith may not be so easy.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elija Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

programme.desc: Five women learn martial arts in order to punish a rapist (Peter Brown) who wears a hockey mask.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: Inspired by the Battle of the Little Bighorn, this Western follows a selfish military leader, Gen. Frederick McCabe (Andrew Duggan), who unfeelingly throws his soldiers into dangerous battle situations, and the soldiers who must follow his orders. While waiting to be sent into combat, two of the men -- Harrod (Tom Tryon) and Rogers (Harve Presnell) -- find themselves in the midst of a love triangle as they both pursue the heart of the beautiful Lou Woddard (Senta Berger).

programme.title: Fort Bowie
programme.desc: A group of Apaches visits a cavalry fort in hopes of laying down their weapons and coming to a peace agreement, but Maj. Wharton (J. Ian Douglas), wanting to make a name for himself, orders his men to massacre them. Meanwhile, Col. Garrett (Kent Taylor) believes his flirtatious wife is sleeping with Capt. Thompson (Ben Johnson), so he tries to get rid of the captain by ordering him to track Victorio (Larry Chance), a notorious Apache warrior who's plotting a large-scale attack on the fort.

programme.title: Southwest Passage
programme.desc: Edward Beale (Rod Cameron) and his caravan are en route to California as part of the U.S. Cavalry's initiative to utilize camels as cargo carriers for desert treks. Beale and his men join up with an escaped bank robber, Clint McDonald (John Ireland), who is impersonating a doctor. When one of Beale's men discovers McDonald's fraud, he blackmails the thief for a share of the bank loot. But then a far more menacing threat emerges in the form of American Indian warriors.

programme.title: Frontier Uprising
programme.desc: A wagon train heads for California unaware that local Indians have sided with Mexico against the United States.

programme.title: Bat Masterson

programme.title: Bat Masterson

programme.title: Tombstone Territory

programme.title: Tombstone Territory

programme.title: Southwest Passage

When one of Beale's men discovers McDonald's fraud, he blackmails the thief for a share of the bank loot. But then a far more menacing threat emerges in the form of American Indian warriors.

programme.title: Fort Massacre
programme.desc: After his cavalry company is decimated by an Apache attack, Vinson takes charge and tries to lead his remaining men to safety. Unfortunately, his pathological hatred of Native Americans causes him to commit rash acts that put his troops in jeopardy. The enlisted men, especially the rebellious McGurney, question Vinson's leadership and even his morality, but the soldiers must stick together if they wish to make it through Apache lands.

programme.title: Trooper Hook
programme.desc: Wanted for killing a squadron of soldiers, Apache Chief Nanchez (Rudolfo Acosta) is finally captured by Sgt. Clovis Hook (Joel McCrea), who discovers among Nanchez's prisoners Cora Sutliff (Barbara Stanwyck), who had been missing for several years. Sutliff has not only fully integrated into the Apache way of life, she also has a son with Nanchez. Now Hook wants to transport her back to her old way of life, but Nanchez isn't willing to let his son be taken from him.

programme.title: Escort West

Although Martha is embittered because her fiancé was killed by a Confederate during the war, she is forced to trust Ben when a band of Native Americans tries to attack the sisters, and the soldier offers his protection.

programme.title: The Glory Guys
programme.desc: Inspired by the Battle of the Little Bighorn, this Western follows a selfish military leader, Gen. While waiting to be sent into combat, two of the men -- Harrod (Tom Tryon) and Rogers (Harve Presnell) -- find themselves in the midst of a love triangle as they both pursue the heart of the beautiful Lou Woddard (Senta Berger).

programme.title: Fort Bowie

programme.title: Bat Masterson

programme.title: Viens souper
programme.desc: Le handicap peut affecter les capacités physiques ou cognitives, mais n'empêche pas forcément une vie sexuelle épanouie ; Dominic accueille, le temps d'un souper, trois personnes pour qui il est primordial de fréquenter le septième ciel.

programme.title: Et si c'était toi?
programme.desc: Jeune retraitée, la pétillante Élodie, 41 ans, cherche une relation sérieuse; lors de ses trois rendez-vous, elle se promène dans un champ avec Geneviève, s'adonne à une activité nautique avec Nancy, et grille des guimauves au bord du feu avec Sarah.

programme.title: Ça me regarde
programme.desc: Un magazine de service qui place le handicap au cœur des préoccupations et est un lieu de rassemblement pour celles et ceux qui vivent avec des limitations fonctionnelles ou qui sont proches de cette réalité.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.sub-title: Un athlète se joint à l'équipe
programme.desc: Le coach propose une campagne de financement douteuse; une application pour identifier les handicaps; Isabelle invite un ami à la piscine, mais sa condition est très particulière.

programme.title: Vestiaires
programme.desc: Stéphane réserve tout un accueil à Mélanie qui ne se laisse pas marcher sur les pieds; à la suite d'une blessure, le coach doit se déplacer en fauteuil roulant; Valérie éprouve un malaise incontrôlable; une altercation éclate au vestiaire.

programme.title: Style sur mesure
programme.desc: Atteinte de paralysie cérébrale depuis la naissance, Claudine rêve de se voir sous un nouveau jour et gagner en confiance ; elle souhaite mettre en lumière la belle jeune femme qu'elle est avec un style éclaté, coloré et féminin.

programme.title: Divergentes
programme.desc: Comment élever un enfant quand on peine déjà à s'occuper de soi ; Coco et Naadei abordent les défis de la maternité ; Kim Rusk ouvre les portes de son quotidien de maman ; Coco rencontre Lucilla, mère d'un garçon autiste et elle-même sur le spectre.

programme.title: Je suis moi, l'artiste!
programme.desc: L'école Les Muses offre une formation professionnelle en théâtre, en chant, en danse et en jeu devant la caméra à de jeunes artistes vivant avec une déficience intellectuelle, un trouble du spectre de l'autisme et des limitations physiques.

programme.title: Mon guide yoga
programme.desc: Notre corps a besoin d'une variété de mouvements pour assurer sa vitalité, sa mobilité, et même pour minimiser les risques de blessures ; on propose des mouvements alternatifs à la posture assise pour maintenir la santé des articulations.

programme.title: La clé Deschamps
programme.desc: Atterri du Nouveau-Brunswick, c'est une belle surprise qu'attend Guy Godin à son arrivée chez Martin ; on entre dans cet univers musical teinté d'un parfum acadien où se rencontrent passion, détermination et conviction au son d'un bon classique.

programme.title: Voir la musique autrement
programme.desc: Le pianiste espagnol Raúl Thaïs Antequera cherche une musique libre de contraintes pendant que le multi-instrumentiste Tcha Limberger, un Rom de Belgique établi en Espagne, a parcouru la planète pour apprendre les différents styles musicaux.

programme.title: Tous en choeur
programme.desc: Une Marche avec Anne-Élisabeth Bossé, une sortie à la cabane à sucre et un concert final réunissant les quatre choeurs. Les choristes montent sur scène, fiers du chemin parcouru et tournés vers l'avenir.

programme.title: Facteur A

programme.title: Les eaux calmes

programme.title: Night Is Not Eternal
programme.desc: Night Is Not Eternal is a deeply personal exploration of political activism through the eyes of Chinese American filmmaker Nanfu Wang. For over seven years, Nanfu follows Rosa Maria Paya, a young Cuban activist and daughter of five-time Nobel Peace Prize nominee Oswaldo Paya, in her fight for democratic change in Cuba. Driven by her own experiences in China, Nanfu is drawn to Rosa's story and the parallels between their homelands. With intimate access, Nanfu follows Rosa's journey from the streets of Havana to rallies and conferences worldwide, capturing her transformation from a grassroots activist to an international public figure and documenting the challenges faced by activists resisting authoritarian regimes.

programme.desc: L'équipe subit un revers frustrant, mais elle est stupéfaite lorsque celui-ci les conduit à faire une grande découverte.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Notre guerre
programme.desc: Un adolescent descendant du légendaire coureur olympique Tom Longboat cherche à découvrir l'histoire de son ancêtre, un vétéran de la Première Guerre mondiale ; cette grande histoire qui se cache derrière sa notoriété d'athlète.

programme.title: Les grands mystères de l'Histoire
programme.desc: La tragique histoire du Titanic captive l'imagination autant du public que des experts ; plus d'un siècle s'est écoulé depuis le naufrage du paquebot, mais tout le monde cherche encore des réponses ; de nouvelles preuves peuvent-elles en révéler davantage sur les circonstances et les réelles raisons du naufrage du Titanic ?

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: La Seconde Guerre mondiale avec Tom Hanks
programme.desc: Les forces aériennes alliées s'engagent dans une bataille féroce qui entraîne de lourdes pertes humaines contre l'armée de l'air allemande, au-dessus du ciel européen.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: La légion oubliée
programme.desc: Les histoires héroïques et les actes de bravoure incroyables des soldats noirs canadiens pendant la Seconde Guerre mondiale ; ceux-ci ont risqué leur vie pour leur pays, tout en faisant face au racisme autant à la maison que sur le champ de bataille.

programme.title: Prisons
programme.desc: Construite pour enfermer les pires criminels, Alcatraz est la destination finale pour les récidivistes et fauteurs de troubles venus d'autres prisons.

programme.title: Les mécanos de Rust Valley
programme.desc: Mike accepte de restaurer un camion GMC de 1957 pour la fille d'un de ses voisins ; celui-ci a une impressionnante liste de demandes, incluant la conversion du moteur afin qu'il brûle de l'alcool comme carburant.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les mécanos de Rust Valley
programme.desc: Le constructeur sur mesure James West achète la Jeep Willys de Mike ; il a une thématique bien précise en tête pour la restauration de ce véhicule ; il souhaite le transformer en un camion inspiré des bombardiers de la Seconde Guerre mondiale.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Zombie Cars: sauvés de la scrap
programme.desc: En 1973, la crise du pétrole favorise l'arrivée massive de petites voitures étrangères en Amérique du Nord. Les constructeurs d'ici se font prendre au dépourvu avec leurs gros modèles et doivent réagir vite. General Motors, en déclin depuis l'échec de sa Chevrolet Vega, mise tout sur le développement accéléré d'une petite voiture économique : la Chevette. Rémi-Pierre nous fait découvrir le modèle qui a sauvé GM et rencontre une fan, pilote de course, qui a conservé sa Chevette par amour.

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.desc: Après avoir considéré une retraite bien méritée, Raymond réalise qu'il ne peut se passer de transiger des voitures ; il fait l'acquisition d'un nouveau bureau qu'il nous présente fièrement.

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.desc: Yannick s'intéresse à un Duster à la carrosserie impeccable, mais Jennifer remarque que le numéro de série est écrit à la main ; au volant, Raymond et Marie-Hélène se rendent en Estrie faire l'acquisition d'un Challenger décapotable.

programme.title: Transmission impossible
programme.desc: Après plus d'un an de travail à faire renaître un Superbird, Michel livre aujourd'hui le célèbre wing car à son client Marc Hamilton ; chez Raymond, Alain et Jocelyn mettent la touche finale à la restauration d'une Pontiac GTO 1971 The Judge ; Yanick et Jennifer accourent chez le collectionneur André Doré, qui, après des décennies à assembler une collection de plus de 100 voitures classiques, vient de décider de s'en départir.

programme.title: Chasseurs de voitures
programme.sub-title: Trésors de la Seconde Guerre mondiale
programme.desc: Jess prend les devants et mène la dernière mission, mais un atterrissage difficile pourrait laisser l'équipe bloquée sans aucune trouvaille en vue.

programme.title: AvGeek
programme.desc: Chez Québec Aéronature, Ghislain accueille son nouvel instructeur de vol de brousse en lui confiant un Cessna dans lequel des oiseaux ont élu domicile pendant l'hiver; chez Ray-Air, Patrick et Junior présentent à Raymond un nouvel avion de retraite.

programme.title: Bécanes de rêve
programme.desc: À son atelier, Samuel Guertin reçoit, en pièces détachées, le projet de moto de son client Julien; à Rivière-du-Loup, Éric Gagnon travaille sur la transmission de son Harley-Davidson FLH, qu'il veut terminer pour l'événement Roll the Bones.

programme.title: La malédiction d'Oak Island
programme.desc: Alors que l'équipe lutte pour empêcher l'eau de se déverser dans le puits du jardin, le lien entre Oak Island, le capitaine Phipps et les Templiers s'intensifie rapidement sur le Lot 5.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les montagnards
programme.desc: Pour son 80e anniversaire, Tom construit un tipi, tandis que Nancy lui prépare une fête surprise; Jake fait sortir un puma de la route pendant la saison de mise bas; Paul transporte sa cabane de piégeage sur une route de montagne étroite et escarpée jusqu'à sa nouvelle propriété; Kidd et Harry creusent le flanc d'une colline pour construire une cave à légumes; Ray fait fondre de l'huile de poisson à partir de dorés fraîchement pêchés pour ses pièges.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les montagnards
programme.desc: Marty installe des flotteurs sur son hydravion et s'envole vers un lac isolé pour chasser l'orignal. Pendant ce temps, Lauro et Neil récoltent du bois pour confectionner un radeau. Ayant dans sa mire un wapiti, Mike s'aventure sur un territoire hostile de l'île d'Afognak. Jake navigue sur la rivière Missouri à la recherche d'un cerf mulet. Puis, Paul pose des pièges à coyotes, désirant utiliser la précieuse fourrure de cet animal pour amasser des fonds pour sa nouvelle propriété.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Les grands mystères de l'Histoire
programme.desc: La recherche de la mine d'or la plus célèbre du Far West a entraîné la mort de nombreuses personnes qui cherchaient à s'approprier cette insaisissable richesse; la légende raconte que l'or et l'endroit où il serait caché sont tous deux maudits! Pourtant, des chasseurs de trésors continuent de se rendre dans ce désert aride de l'Arizona, connu sous le nom de la montagne de la Superstition, pour tenter de mettre la main sur cet or, mais où se cache exactement la mine perdue du Hollandais?

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: La vie après nous
programme.desc: En l'absence de présence humaine, les villes les plus emblématiques du monde, telles New York, Orlando et Rio de Janeiro, sont reconquises par la nature: les forêts gagnent du terrain, les animaux errent en liberté, puis les incendies et les inondations anéantissent des siècles de construction; des grands magasins envahis par les singes aux tours et statues qui s'effondrent, voici l'histoire de la reconquête des merveilles urbaines par la nature sauvage.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Secrets déclassifiés avec David Duchovny
programme.desc: Quand on dit qu'une mission est impossible, est-ce vraiment seulement une expression ? Des plongeurs ont atteint des profondeurs dangereuses afin d'intercepter une ligne de communication soviétique secrète. Une équipe spéciale de soldats a été déployée pour déclencher manuellement des bombes atomiques en territoire ennemi. De nombreuses preuves plus stupéfiantes les unes que les autres témoignent de ce que certains sont prêts à faire pour accomplir une mission dite impossible.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: La malédiction d'Oak Island
programme.desc: Rick et Marty vont dans le puits du jardin pour la première fois cette année, mais ils risquent de rester pris dans un ancien piège.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Là pour rester
programme.desc: À 16 ans, l'amateur de plein air Louis Grenier se fabrique un vêtement sur mesure pour ne plus avoir froid durant ses expéditions hivernales; Larry Rossy monte un véritable empire en créant une chaîne de magasins dont tous les produits se vendent 1$.

programme.title: Là pour rester
programme.sub-title: La technologie IMAX et la chaise Solair
programme.desc: Une innovation technique projette l'inventivité québécoise aux quatre coins du monde, redéfinissant l'expérience cinématographique ; il s'agit de la technologie IMAX ; la chaise Solair passe de mobilier à une pièce de collection dans les musées.

programme.title: La bouffe qui a forgé le monde
programme.sub-title: Un empire au coin de la rue
programme.desc: Le tout premier dépanneur voit le jour. Grâce à de pertinentes innovations comme des heures d'ouverture tardives, le café à emporter et une boisson glacée adorée des Américains, il devient une chaîne emblématique comptant plus d'établissements que n'importe quel autre restaurant ou magasin au monde.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Tout sur le menu avec Braun Strowman
programme.desc: Braun Strowman démolit Miami avec style, apportant son appétit dans l'une des villes les plus dynamiques et riches en matière de diversité culinaire. La mission est claire: avaler les meilleurs burgers et faire un pèlerinage au légendaire Phuc Yea, restaurant plébiscité pour son audacieuse fusion Viet-Cajun. Le copilote de Braun est le célèbre Hall of Famer de baseball Mike Piazza, qui apporte à table la même intensité du tout ou rien que celle qui le définissait dans la boîte du frappeur.

programme.title: Steak, blé d'Inde, patates
programme.desc: Depuis 110 ans, les membres des Cercles de Fermières sont des gardiennes du patrimoine culinaire partout au Québec. Pionnières de l'autonomie alimentaire, elles tissent des liens entre les générations.

programme.title: Les jouets qui ont forgé le monde

programme.desc: Le secteur des jeux de société s'adressait presque aux enfants, jusqu'à l'arrivée d'un véritable jeu révolutionnaire: Trivial Pursuit; en redéfinissant les possibilités de divertissement, il a ouvert la voie à un tout nouveau genre.

programme.desc: Les derniers mots d'un chasseur d'or lancent Adam, Kru et Daryl Friesen dans une quête glaciale au-dessus du lac Pitt. programme.title: La malédiction d'Oak Island
programme.desc: Le groupe enquête sur un chevalier de Malte qui aurait visité l'île par le passé; pendant ce temps, les membres de l'équipe captent, sur vidéo, un possible trésor enfoui sous terre.

programme.desc: De nouvelles recherches sur le site du mystérieux triangle révèlent la présence de plusieurs phénomènes aérospatiaux non identifiés; l'équipe fait une découverte incroyable dans le ruisseau bordant la portion sud de la propriété.

programme.title: Les Pierrafeu
programme.desc: Les Pierrafeu étaient la famille moderne de l'âge de la Pierre. Résidant dans la ville Saint-Granit, Fred Caillou n'était pas satisfait de son travail à la carrière, mais revenait à la maison auprès de sa charmante épouse Wilma et, enfin de sa fille Agathe. Fred, un grand amateur de golf et de quilles aimait aussi taquiner son voisin Arthur Laroche, tandis que la femme coquine d'Arthur, Bertha était la meilleure amie de Wilma. Au cours de l'émission, Barney et Betty ont adopté un fils anormalement fort, Bamm-Bamm, qui allait devenir plus tard ami avec Agathe. Les Pierrafeu, fortement inspiré par "The Honeymooners" ont convaincu une génération d'enfants que dinosaures et humains ont occupé la planète en même temps.

programme.title: Les Pierrafeu
programme.desc: Les Pierrafeu étaient la famille moderne de l'âge de la Pierre. Résidant dans la ville Saint-Granit, Fred Caillou n'était pas satisfait de son travail à la carrière, mais revenait à la maison auprès de sa charmante épouse Wilma et, enfin de sa fille Agathe. Fred, un grand amateur de golf et de quilles aimait aussi taquiner son voisin Arthur Laroche, tandis que la femme coquine d'Arthur, Bertha était la meilleure amie de Wilma. Au cours de l'émission, Barney et Betty ont adopté un fils anormalement fort, Bamm-Bamm, qui allait devenir plus tard ami avec Agathe. Les Pierrafeu, fortement inspiré par "The Honeymooners" ont convaincu une génération d'enfants que dinosaures et humains ont occupé la planète en même temps.

programme.desc: El prestigioso torneo con el que concluye el circuito ATP reúne a los ocho mejores jugadores del año, quienes buscan el título de 'Maestro'. programme.title: EuroCup
programme.desc: La EuroCup, la segunda en el escalafón continental de competiciones de clubes de baloncesto, otorga doble premio. El más obvio, el del título. Para el vencedor, además, hay un pase a la próxima Euroliga. El torneo cambia este año de formato, ampliándose a 32 equipos.

programme.title: Euroliga
programme.desc: La máxima competición continental de baloncesto reincide en su formato consolidado de 20 equipos y una intensa fase regular de 38 jornadas. programme.title: Finales ATP
programme.desc: El prestigioso torneo con el que concluye el circuito ATP reúne a los ocho mejores jugadores del año, quienes buscan el título de 'Maestro'. programme.title: Una vida en diez fotos
programme.desc: Una mirada más allá de la visión popular sobre la carrera de David Beckham para descubrir una historia más profunda: cómo el futbolista utilizó su imagen para transformarse en una marca global.

programme.title: Fútbol Club Maradona
programme.desc: No se puede entender lo que es Maradona, en toda su dimensión, sin su paso por el FC Barcelona. El argentino y el club azulgrana cruzaron sus caminos a principios de los años 80 y la mezcla de esa relación resultó complicada. Es la historia de un mito que se adelantó a su tiempo, tanto en el campo como en repercusión mediática, y de un club que no estaba preparado para asumir semejante personalidad. Testigos directos de su paso por Barcelona como Joan Gaspart, Josep María Minguella, Lobo Carrasco, Marcos Alonso o Menotti, descubren los detalles de los dos años en los que Diego transformó el FC Barcelona y en los que también Barcelona transformó a Maradona.

programme.title: Informe Plus+. Golden Boys 2.0. El relevo del baloncesto español
programme.desc: En 1999 una nueva generación de jugadores españoles llamaba a las puertas de la selección absoluta después de conquistar el Mundial Junior de Lisboa. 24 años después una renovada hornada de jóvenes españoles ha retomado el camino marcado en su día por Pau Gasol, Navarro, Felipe Reyes y Raúl López. El baloncesto que han conocido Izan Almansa, Baba Miller, Aday Mara y compañía poco tiene que ver con el de finales del siglo XX. El potencial, ambición y ganas de hacer historia de esta nueva generación son idénticos.

programme.title: Bien hecho. La extraordinaria historia de Javier García Pajares
programme.desc: Javier es una persona con sordoceguera al que sus limitaciones no le han impedido realizar actos asombrosos. Tanto él como las personas de su entorno describen cómo es la historia de una persona que ha conseguido superar retos que parecían imposibles.

programme.title: Kroos. La familia y el fútbol
programme.desc: El camino hacia el éxito de Toni Kroos, pero también el precio que cada miembro de la familia tuvo que pagar por ello. Una mirada poco común e inusualmente abierta a la vida mental de una famosa familia de atletas. En el fútbol profesional, solo la superficie suele estar expuesta al mundo exterior para proteger la marca. La película muestra la ambivalencia entre el glamour del Real Madrid y la costa de Alemania del Este. Una historia de fondo íntima sobre uno de los hijos más famosos de Oriente y su familia, que se mantienen unidos a pesar de todos los desafíos.

programme.title: Hermanos y Enemigos (Petrovic y Divac)
programme.desc: Drazen Petrovic, de Croacia, y Vlade Divac, de Serbia, fueron dos jugadores clave en la selección de básquet yugoslava y gracias a su talento lograron triunfar en la NBA. Pero la amistad que les unió se vio afectada por el inicio de la guerra de los Balcanes (1991), cuando Croacia declaró su independencia. Los dos amigos no volvieron a dirigirse la palabra y Petrovic murió en un accidente de coche antes de que pudieran reconciliarse. Este documental forma parte de la serie '30 for 30' de la ESPN (Entertainment and Sports Programming Network) en motivo de su 30 aniversario en 2009. En esta colección se repasa la historia del deporte estadounidense a través de las anécdotas y curiosidades más destacables de las últimas tres décadas. La cadena de televisión, dedicada exclusivamente al ámbito deportivo, encargó cada uno de los documentales a distintos directores de Hollywood como Bill Couturié ('Cartas des de Vietnam'), Reggie Rock Bythewood ('Sombras de Nueva York') y el director de este filme Michael Tolajian ('Hermanos y Enemigos (Petrovic y Divac)'), entre otros. El resultado de este ambicioso y arriesgado proyecto fue todo un éxito.

programme.desc: El partidazo de la jornada lo firmarán Liverpool y Manchester United, dos clásicos del fútbol inglés, los más laureados de las islas británicas y un duelo de 'Reds' que se vivirá con pasión en Anfield.

programme.title: Champions League
programme.desc: Atlético y Bayern se citan en el Metropolitano. Separados por un punto (16º vs 14º), ambos urgen ganar. El Atleti llega con 7 triunfos seguidos en Liga, pero con bajas en el medio; el Bayern lidera invicto en Alemania con un Harry Kane letal.

programme.title: Finales ATP
programme.desc: Los Masters 1000 son los torneos más importantes después de los Grand Slam y forman parte del ATP Tour. Se celebran en Norteamérica, Europa y Asia y se juegan en pista rápida y tierra batida. El Campeón consigue 1000 puntos para el ranking ATP.

programme.title: EuroCup
programme.desc: La EuroCup, la segunda en el escalafón continental de competiciones de clubes de baloncesto, otorga doble premio. El más obvio, el del título. Para el vencedor, además, hay un pase a la próxima Euroliga. El torneo cambia este año de formato, ampliándose a 32 equipos.

programme.title: Finales ATP
programme.desc: El prestigioso torneo con el que concluye el circuito ATP reúne a los ocho mejores jugadores del año, quienes buscan el título de 'Maestro'. La cita, del 15 al 22 de noviembre en Turín, cuenta con dos españoles: Carlos Alcaraz (gran favorito junto a Zverev) y el debutante Rafa Jódar.

programme.title: Euroliga
programme.desc: La máxima competición continental de baloncesto reincide en su formato consolidado de 20 equipos y una intensa fase regular de 38 jornadas. Una exigente competición que cuenta con Valencia Basket, Real Madrid, Barcelona y Baskonia como representantes españoles. Olympiacos defiende título.

programme.title: Informe Plus+. Briganti. Rugby vs mafia
programme.desc: Librino es uno de los barrios más problemáticos de Sicilia en el que droga, delincuencia y abandono escolar conforman el paisaje cotidiano. En un territorio controlado por la Mafia, Piero Mancuso se aferra al deporte para plantarle cara a la marginalidad. De la mano del Rugby y de sus valores un hombre se enfrenta a la Cosa Nostra para que los jóvenes no sean reclutados por ella y sí por un proyecto de vida y futuro.

programme.title: Objetivo: París
programme.desc: Decidida a frenar los planes de Voltov, Zara recluta a un grupo de antiguos mercenarios para llevar a cabo una peligrosa misión en Bengasi. Mientras tanto, Vincent busca ayuda en un viejo conocido y Yuri Mishkin prepara su siguiente movimiento.

programme.title: Objetivo: París
programme.desc: Con la ayuda de un antiguo colaborador de Vincent, Zara y su compañero planean infiltrarse en la base de Voltov para rescatar a Rachel y a los demás rehenes. Mientras tanto, Yuri Mishkin intenta doblegar a Keane para conseguir sus objetivos.

programme.title: Objetivo: París
programme.desc: La investigación lleva a Zara y Vincent hasta España, donde intentan localizar a la familia de Rachel y obtener nuevas pistas sobre los planes de Voltov. Mientras Yuri prepara su ataque biológico, una fuente inesperada les ofrece información decisiva.

programme.title: Objetivo: París
programme.desc: Final de temporada. Los planes de Yuri Mishkin entran en su fase más peligrosa y Zara y Vincent deben actuar antes de que sea demasiado tarde. Una amenaza biológica de consecuencias devastadoras los enfrenta a una misión decisiva.

programme.title: Celeste
programme.desc: La inspectora de Hacienda Sara Santano recibe un último encargo el día de su jubilación: demostrar que la popular cantante Celeste ha residido en España 184 días, el mínimo para declarar. La mitad del año más uno.

programme.title: Celeste
programme.desc: Sara encuentra a dos aliados inesperados en su investigación: Dani, una joven recién incorporada a la Agencia Tributaria, y Tony, un 'paparazzo' que lleva años siguiendo a Celeste.

programme.title: Celeste
programme.desc: Sara y Carmelo solicitan autorización al delegado de la Agencia Tributaria para citar a Celeste, pero Sara tiene dificultades para encontrar los 184 días. La presión crece, así que Sara toma algunos atajos para conseguir información.

programme.title: Celeste
programme.desc: La investigación de Celeste despierta fantasmas de la vida personal de Sara, mientras ella se queda sin recursos para acorralar a la cantante. Carmelo sospecha de los métodos de Sara.

programme.title: Celeste
programme.desc: Celeste es una gran estrella de la música latina, pero la protagonista de esta historia es Sara Santano: una inspectora de Hacienda que, justo antes de jubilarse, recibe el encargo de demostrar que la artista es culpable de fraude fiscal.

programme.title: Celeste
programme.desc: Episodio final. Sara no está dispuesta a rendirse, así que decide gastar una última bala que le puede abrir la puerta a la información que le falta. Y solo hay una fuente posible de donde conseguirla.

programme.title: Prime Minister
programme.desc: Jacinda Ardern desde que juró su cargo como primera ministra de Nueva Zelanda con 37 años, anunció su embarazo, se convirtió en madre y lidió con los complejos retos que ocasiona el liderazgo.

programme.title: Informe Robinson
programme.desc: Son dos hermanos de Vitoria: Iker y Eneko Pou. Escalan las paredes más difíciles del planeta allí por dónde nadie más lo había hecho antes. Por algo están entre los mejores escaladores del mundo.

programme.title: Narcogallegos
programme.desc: En marzo de 2023, un gran narcosubmarino cargado con 5.000 kilos de cocaína llega a la Ría de Arousa. Varias organizaciones trabajan para recoger la droga y consiguen hacerlo evitando a las autoridades. Un año después, la Policía consigue atar cabos.

programme.title: Narcogallegos
programme.desc: La Policía Nacional registra viviendas del círculo de Miñanco. Les atribuye el intento de descarga del narcosubmarino. Mientras, la UCO anuncia un hito sin precedentes: la desarticulación de los principales tentáculos del Cártel de Los Balcanes.

programme.title: La película de nazis que nunca existió
programme.desc: Herman J. Mankiewicz, guionista de 'Ciudadano Kane', escribió en 1932 'The Mad Dog of Europe', un guion antinazi que retrataba la desintegración de una familia judío-alemana en los inicios de Hitler en el poder. Este visionario guion nunca se rodó.

programme.title: Las hijas del Reich
programme.desc: 1939, Inglaterra. Miller, un profesor de literatura, empieza a trabajar en una escuela que forma a hijas de altos cargos nazis. Al poco de su llegada, aparece en las proximidades un cadáver que dispara todas las alarmas y pone en jaque a la institución.

programme.title: Bien hecho. La extraordinaria historia de Javier García Pajares
programme.desc: Javier es una persona con sordoceguera al que sus limitaciones no le han impedido realizar actos asombrosos. Tanto él como las personas de su entorno describen cómo es la historia de una persona que ha conseguido superar retos que parecían imposibles.
